_what: What scripts/package.mjs downloads into a ready-made package, pinned by sha256 (ADR-278). A download that does not match is refused. To move a pin: download the new file, run sha256sum on it (Node's are also in its signed SHASUMS256.txt), and change url + sha256 here in the same PR. A platform is packaged only when it has an entry.

pgTools._source: EDB's PostgreSQL binaries zip, the build the PostgreSQL download page links for Windows; the same major (18) and minor as the embedded server. Only the two client tools and the DLLs they load are taken.

EDB's PostgreSQL binaries zip for macOS, the build the PostgreSQL download page links (universal: Apple silicon and Intel in one file); the same 18.x as the embedded server and the Windows tools. Only the two client tools and the libraries they load (read from their Mach-O load commands) are taken, keeping EDB's bin/ + lib/ layout because the tools find their libraries at @loader_path/../lib.

PostgreSQL's own apt repository (apt.postgresql.org; apt-archive keeps every version, so the pin never moves under us), the Ubuntu 22.04 build of postgresql-client-18 at the embedded server's version. It needs glibc 2.34+ and the system's libcrypto.so.3, liblz4 and libzstd (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Fedora 36+). Its libpq comes from the embedded server's own portable build instead of apt's (which links a different LDAP library on each Ubuntu release); package.mjs writes a wrapper in pgtools/bin that points the loader at pgtools/lib.
